# HalfPast Meter

> HalfPast Meter is a Home Assistant custom integration (domain `bright_meter`, MIT) that imports a UK smart meter's half-hourly electricity and gas readings, and their cost, as hourly external statistics for the Energy dashboard. It reads them from Hildebrand's Glowmarkt API, the service behind the free Bright app, so it works with any supplier whose SMETS2 meter Bright can read. It installs through HACS as a custom repository.

Key facts:

- Needs: Home Assistant 2026.9 or newer, and a Bright account that already shows usage.
- Install: in HACS, add `https://github.com/CaputoDavide93/HalfPast-Meter` as a custom repository of type Integration, download HalfPast Meter, restart. Without HACS, copy `custom_components/bright_meter/` into `config/custom_components/`.
- Statistics: `bright_meter:electricity_consumption`, `_consumption_cost`, `electricity_export`, `gas_consumption`, `gas_consumption_cost`. These ids and the domain must never be renamed: it orphans the imported history.
- Gaps stay gaps (no row), real zeros import, the last week is re-read every pass, clock-change days (23 and 25 hours) are handled.
- Not live: the feed is half-hourly and 30 minutes to two days late. No live power.
- Tested: pytest suite against a real recorder on Home Assistant 2026.9.4, Python 3.14, and on the newest release as a canary. Run on one live Bright account.
- Unverified: DCC catch-up rate limit, which half-hour carries the standing charge, tariff payload shape, gas in m3, DCC-only accounts, several sites.
- Checks: `make venv` once, then `make check`.
- Independent project, not affiliated with Hildebrand or Glow.
